# Contributing to Dogokit Akita

Thanks for helping out.

This repo is documentation only. It is a curated reference of tools, stack choices and guides. It has no app features to build.

## Ways to help

- Report a problem or suggest a change: open an [issue](https://github.com/dogokit/dogokit-akita/issues) using a template
- Fix or add docs: open a pull request
- Ask a question: use [Discussions](https://github.com/dogokit/dogokit-akita/discussions)

## Make a change

1. Fork the repo and clone it
2. Create a branch from `main`: `git checkout -b your-branch-name`
3. Install dependencies: `vp install`
4. Make your change
5. Run the checks: `vp run check`
6. Commit with a [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) message, such as `docs: fix link in stack note`
7. Push and open a pull request into `main`

## Good to know

- Agent rules live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)
- AI agent skills live in [.claude/skills](../.claude/skills/README.md)
